featured_reviews.name: HARISH KHARVI
featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely Stunning Wedding Photos – Thank You, UR FUN PHOTOGRAPHERR!

I can’t stop smiling while going through all the incredible photos from my brother’s wedding—thanks to UR FUN PHOTOGRAPHERR! From the Haldi to the Reception, Rahul Gor and his team captured every laugh, tear, and dance move so perfectly that it feels like we’re reliving the best moments all over again.

What I loved most was how natural and fun they made everything. No stiff poses or forced smiles—just pure, joyful moments frozen in time. They blended into the crowd yet somehow managed to catch all the little details we would’ve missed. The candid shots? Chef’s kiss! And the way they played with lighting and angles in the portraits? Absolutely magical.

A massive shoutout to Rahul and his team for being so patient, creative, and full of positive energy throughout all the events. You didn’t just take photos—you gave us memories we’ll treasure forever.

If you want a photographer who’s talented, easygoing, and genuinely passionate about their work, UR FUN PHOTOGRAPHERR is the one. 10/10, would recommend to everyone!

Thanks again for making our wedding celebrations even more special. You guys rock!

With love,
Harish Kharvi

featured_reviews.name: Uday Kharvi
featured_reviews.review_text:
UR FUN Photographer team — words honestly fall short for the kind of magic you guys created for us. From Day 1, you weren’t just vendors, you became part of our celebration, part of our memories. From the Sangeet to Haldi, Mehendi, Wedding, and Reception — every event was beautifully captured with so much passion, creativity, and precision.

What truly sets you apart is your vision — every shot was unique, every angle so thoughtfully taken, every emotion so perfectly frozen in time. Your editing skills? Next level. We were stunned by how fast you delivered such high-quality content — vibrant, cinematic, and full of soul. Every reel, every photo, every frame tells a story we’ll relive for the rest of our lives.

Rahul and the entire UR FUN team, hats off to you. You gave us more than just pictures and videos — you gave us the feeling of those moments all over again. Your team is super professional, insanely talented, and above all, you truly care. That shows in every detail.

This isn’t just a recommendation — it’s a shoutout from the heart. If you’re planning any event, trust these guys blindly. They’ll not only capture your moments, they’ll turn them into timeless memories.

Thank you, thank you, thank you — for being part of the most important days of our lives, and for doing it with so much fun, energy, and love. You guys are unreal!
